categories.main_business_segments: Yunnan Aluminium Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the integrated aluminum industry, including bauxite mining, alumina production, green aluminum smelting, aluminum processing, and carbon products manufacturing. Its main products include alumina, aluminum anode carbon, graphite cathodes, remelting aluminum ingots, high-precision aluminum, aluminum rods, aluminum alloys, and welding materials. The company also engages in circular economy initiatives such as aluminum waste recycling and resource utilization of aluminum dross and red mud.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as photovoltaic power direct current integration for aluminum electrolysis, large-scale electrolytic cell maintenance residue harmless and resource utilization, and aluminum dross resource recycling production lines. It has developed key technologies in aluminum electrolysis energy saving, carbon material production, high-end aluminum alloy welding materials, and intelligent manufacturing. The company also uses a green aluminum integrated production model certified by ASI, emphasizing low-carbon, clean energy utilization mainly from hydropower.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yunnan Aluminium serves industries including automotive lightweighting, rail transit, defense and military, packaging, aluminum furniture, power electronics, and electronics. It targets high-end markets such as photovoltaic power, defense, rail transit, and electronics sectors. The company has established stable supply chain relationships with many domestic and international well-known enterprises, leveraging its green aluminum brand to expand market share.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production facilities located in Yunnan Province including Kunming, Wenshan, Qujing, and other cities. It benefits from Yunnan's abundant green hydropower resources. The company also leverages its strategic location near the South China market and emerging markets in Central China and the Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, as well as access to Southeast Asia and South Asia via the Belt and Road Initiative and regional railways.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunnan Aluminium operates an upstream to downstream integrated supply chain covering bauxite mining, alumina refining, electrolytic aluminum smelting, aluminum alloy production, and aluminum processing. It also produces carbon materials essential for aluminum electrolysis, positioning itself as a fully integrated aluminum producer with resource control and cost advantages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes green, low-carbon development and circular economy, focusing on green aluminum integrated production and resource recycling technologies. R&D efforts target energy-saving electrolysis technologies, high-end aluminum alloys for aerospace and electronics, aluminum welding materials, and intelligent manufacturing systems. It also invests in photovoltaic power projects and aims to enhance product value through alloying and high-purity aluminum development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of aluminum products including electrolytic aluminum, aluminum alloys, alumina, and carbon products. The company also earns income from related services such as logistics and trading. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to industrial customers domestically, with no significant subscription or licensing revenue reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunnan Aluminium is one of China's largest green aluminum producers and the largest green low-carbon aluminum supplier domestically. It holds a leading position in the industry with advanced technology and certifications. Its main competitor landscape includes other large integrated aluminum producers in China, but Yunnan Aluminium differentiates itself through its green energy advantage and full ASI certification across the aluminum value chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 42.67 billion, a decrease of about 12% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 3.96 billion, down 13%. Total assets were about RMB 39.31 billion, with net assets of RMB 25.73 billion, reflecting steady scale and profitability. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunnan Aluminium emphasizes its green aluminum brand, leveraging abundant renewable hydropower to produce low-carbon aluminum with carbon emissions about 20% of coal-based aluminum. It is the only domestic company certified by ASI across the entire aluminum production chain, offering environmentally friendly products with superior energy efficiency and resource recycling capabilities. The company focuses on high-quality, high-purity, and high-end aluminum products tailored for emerging industries, providing customers with sustainable and differentiated aluminum solutions.
